# Felionoid
Felionoids are a small, feline species that is very quick and nimble.
## Racial Features - Their blood has a dark red color. - They are more frail, [color=#ffa500]falling into crit at 85 damage and dying at 170 damage[/color]. - They [color=#1e90ff]can run 25% faster[/color] [color=yellow]when not wearing shoes[/color]. They [color=#1e90ff]run 5% faster when wearing shoes[/color]. - Their claws deal [color=red]3[/color] slash damage with unarmed attacks but attack twice as fast. - Their standard body heat is 37 degrees Celcius and they can withstand temperatures between -15 and 50 degrees Celcius.
## Weapon Knockback Resomi are incredibly lightweight, and thus they have difficulty using weapons that are any bigger than pistols or SMGs. Shooting any other weapon will cause them to take stamina damage and get pushed back. Rocket launchers, since they are recoil-less, will actually [color=red]pull Resomi forward with the rocket[/color] for a short distance. Stamina resistance will help mitigate some of the effects of knockback, but will never completely negate it.
## Nekomimetic The Felionoid language, known as Nekomimetic, is composed of a series of meows and trills. It is described as an incomprehensible mess that is oddly similar to broken Human Japanese and is thus somewhat easy to learn for other species.
## Age and Names Felionoids have a lifespan similar to that of humans, reaching adulthood at 18 years of age and living up to 140 years. Their names may change several times throughout their lives and they are composed of a prefix, usually related to nature, an action or an atribute, followed by a suffix, usually related to the prefix or nature.
